contract_reason: Detection layer for the 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-10 silent alerts-OS outage. Conflicted reference_levels provenance produced freshness_decay on 18 of 18 tickers for six trading days while every chain stage returned rc=0 and status ok, so a silent OS was indistinguishable from a healthy one. This guard makes pin expiry, provenance conflict, pin integrity failure, and a silently non-actionable OS observable on a daily cadence.
description: Deterministic daily read-only guard on the alerts-OS reference baseline. Detects pin expiry, conflicted reference_levels provenance (the 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-10 six-day silent-outage condition), baseline pin integrity failure, and a silently non-actionable alerts OS. Reports only. No canon mutation, capital, orders, accounts, external delivery, or execution authority.
name: Finance - Daily Alert Reference Baseline Freshness Guard

proof.chain_run_recency: silent_os also warns when the newest chain run exceeds --max-chain-run-age-hours (default 120.0, above the ~113h holiday-weekend gap), covering the case where the chain stops writing entirely and the stale files still parse as healthy
proof.false_negative_replay: check_silent_os replayed against 70 real chain-run files from the 2026-09-08/09 outage window returns warn with silent_run_count 4, all freshness_decay dominant, triggered by the silent-window rule rather than recency
proof.false_positive_replay: check_silent_os against the real 2026-09-11 post-close window (4 consecutive monitor_only 18 runs) returns ok
proof.live_run: status ok, all four checks ok, pin 12.97 days remaining
proof.read_only_enforcement: sqlite3.connect(file:...?mode=ro, uri=True); a write attempt raises sqlite3.OperationalError and is asserted in the test suite
